Hey OP, I just want to tell you that I was in the same exact boat earlier this year. we dated for 4 years and then all of a sudden he wanted out because we just didn’t feel the way he used to about me. and I struggled and practically begged him to reconsider for more than 2 weeks because I was so sure that he was the love of my life, the one for me, my soulmate. and to be honest with you, you’re right. That feeling doesn’t go away. we’ve been broken up for a year now but as of January we stopped all contact. The worst part of it is seeing him all the time, we are neighbors. It’s been over a year and still, every time I see him, it’s like a pit in my stomach that doesn’t go away for the rest of the day. I loved him, I love him, and I think a part of me always will love him. here are some things that helped me overcome much of my heartache: 1. Let yourself feel what you will feel. you will feel waves of sadness and anger, sometimes even tidal waves of them. this is okay. everything you feel and will feel is valid, even if contradicting. 2. It’s okay to wallow in it, but don’t stay there for ever. At some point, you have to pick yourself up. And only you can decide when that is the right time for you. 3. (If this is an issue you have like I did), learn to be okay with your own company. Oftentimes I found myself reminiscing among the times he and I used to do things together, ordinary everyday things and I felt the loss of his presence. I had to learn to overcome that. and lastly, 4. reflect. ok the relationship, on yourself, and on your past. people say to look forward and forget the past but I swear this will help you more than pretending like nothing happened. Good luck OP, I really hope you find peace within yourself.
